programs.description: An advocate disappears after his journalist-wife uncovers a shocking trail of corruption involving a powerful politician. When all hope seems lost, a stranger offers to help the couple secure justice.
Udaharanam Sujatha
After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.
Kuttiraman returns to his native village after earning a lot of money to marry his lover. However, things take a turn when his family plots to use his hard-earned money to pay off their debts.
Mohan and Yamuna fall in love with each other and get married. However, their marriage hits troubled waters after Mohan confesses that he unexpectedly cheated on her with one of her friends.
Mini and Sudhish's romance flourishes beneath the disapproving gaze of their families, but the road ahead remains shrouded in a fog of uncertainty.
Fate intertwines the lives of Nandan and Thara, two hearts mending from lost love, leading them to discover a second chance at happiness together.
A man's life takes a turn for the better when he is chosen as an actor while working as an assistant at a theatre troupe.
Stephen, a quadriplegic, befriends John, a musician, and they develop a good rapport. However, their friendship is put to the test when Anjali enters their lives.
An honest police officer decides to avenge his family after his wife gets raped and his daughter suffers a bullet wound. He kills the man who is responsible for this, thus, starting a chain reaction.
Frustrated by systemic corruption, a group of friends creates an interactive website to take complaints from the common man, transforming themselves into vigilantes dedicated to safeguarding society.
